data.name: Alive Hunter 2 Mugen hunt
data.detailed_description:
Alive Hunter 2 is a third person shooter, open world game with cinematic narrative, it's a direct sequel of Alive Hunter (2019)

Steve Wilson a ex criminal tried to live a life being a police officer, he meet a girl named miya, his police partner, but things aren't easy, steve left the job and got involved on something bigger, he find his twin broher, who proven being a psychophat, Steve has to murder his own brother, years after that events, Steve is older and angrier, after Meeting his long time partner miya, he must enter a new world: the futuristic metropolis of neo rumbler city.

He find that his brother is somehow alive and a bigger treat have appeared, the major of the city, a cruel ambicious man with a montain of a ego.

Many treats will close Steve path and way more questions pop up on a completely New adventure that will Challenge the thoughts of Steve and the players, on this journey that IS the last hunt and the epic conclusion of Steve's tale.


PEAK GAMEPLAY 

Alive Hunter 2 made a Lot of improvements on the gameplay, new freatures, combat mechanics and world exploration.

 The Game now have more playable characters, not just reskin, these characters have unique gameplay mechanics and now they work together with Steve with combined attacks and allies system.

A new city is presented, neo rumbler city is full of buildings and a lot of vertical exploration adding another layer of exploration.

NO BULSHIT SEQUEL

so, this is like the sequels released recently, that actually feel like a shitty DLC for a Full price?

No fucking way. This one is like the old games where sequel actually mean something, this is big, Very different that the First game, it's not a complement of the First game, this is the change of everything.

THE ZERO "A" GAME

Cute, now we have AAAA games, but guess what? this one is the zero A game.

Game made entirely by one person, original assets, zero budget, This game come to prove that games are about ideas not about money.

Made by a player for the players, let's beat the triple A industry, let's turn them into ashes and start the New era of games, games without ceo's and bureaucracy.

EMBRACE THE HUNT 

Alive Hunter 2 is a climax from beginning to the end, designed to impact and delivery the most epic journey ever.

Do not fear the hunt, be a part of it.

Let's fucking go.

-

CREATED AND DEVELOPED BY ARMANDO RODRIGUES 

With the great voices of

The Shattered Exile, Valerie Macias, Beau Sterling and John Becker
